Our Story

Priya Collection

Priya Collection is a family-run fashion boutique based in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh — just a short drive from Indore. Founded with a simple belief: every woman deserves to feel beautiful, whether dressing for a daily outing or a grand wedding.

Owner Jalaj Jain handpicks every piece — from crisp cotton kurtis and trendy western tops, to embroidered silk suit sets and elegant evening gowns. Quality, honest pricing and personal service are at the heart of everything we do.

We also serve wholesale and gifting — coordinated return-gift sets, bulk festive orders, and shopkeeper-friendly pricing across MP. Delivering across Madhya Pradesh at just ₹49 flat.
